core.title: Declare acceptance telemetry signals as artifact-based telemetry URNs
core.given: An acceptance is being created or revised
core.when: The planner writes the acceptance and its telemetry signals
core.then: Every acceptance declares telemetry signals (REQUIRED) named as artifact-based URNs: metric telemetry:metric:{plane}:{artifact}[.{category}]:{measure}; trace telemetry:trace:{plane}:{artifact}[.{category}] (no measure); log optional telemetry:log:...; event telemetry:event:... or Title Case analytics name.
prefer: Planes: ui, ux, be, db, nw, st, tm, sc, au, fn, if.
avoid: Metrics not derived from 'then' quantifiable expectations, or events not derived from 'when' user actions (both MUST).
Operations or wagons (bounded product slices) in the URN: they MUST go in signal attributes.
A resource that is not a past-tense verb from the lexicon (MUST).
A measure on a trace; a measure mismatched to artifact kind; a plane/measure outside the lists.
core.why: Artifact-based URNs give every acceptance verifiable, uniformly named telemetry; operations and wagons in attributes keep URNs stable and low-cardinality.
evidence: Each acceptance has at least one declared telemetry signal.

Each metric URN matches telemetry:metric:{plane}:{artifact}[.{category}]:{measure} with plane and measure from the allowed lists; each trace URN matches telemetry:trace:{plane}:{artifact}[.{category}] with no measure.
Every metric traces back to a quantifiable 'then' expectation and every event to a 'when' user action.
No URN segment names an operation or wagon; operations/wagons appear as signal attributes.
The resource segment is a past-tense verb from the lexicon.
verification: REQUIRED obligation: an acceptance with no declared telemetry signal, or with a signal URN violating the shapes or allowed lists, is a violation, not a style suggestion.

Scope: acceptance artifacts being created or revised, however the stack's role assignment identifies them (file kind / path per the profile). The check does not cover code-level telemetry emission or artifacts that are not acceptances.

Mechanically checkable: at least one signal per acceptance; metric/trace/log/event URN shape; plane and measure drawn from the allowed lists; no measure on a trace; measure matched to artifact kind (entity nouns vs past-tense event verbs); no operation or wagon segment in any URN.

Not established by shape checks alone: derivation of each metric from a quantifiable 'then' expectation and of each event from a 'when' user action, and membership of the resource segment in the past-tense verb lexicon, are judged against the acceptance's own when/then text and the lexicon held by the realization.
Optional kinds: log signals are optional (telemetry:log:... when present); an event may be a telemetry:event:... URN or a Title Case analytics name.

fires: Planner writes a new acceptance (with or without a signal section yet).
Planner revises any part of an existing acceptance, including then/when-only edits.
Planner revises an acceptance that is missing required telemetry signals.
Planner adds or changes a metric, trace, log or event signal on an acceptance.
doesNotFire: Editing a wagon (bounded product slice), plan artifact or doc artifact that is not an acceptance.
Code-level implementation of telemetry emission (coder concern, not acceptance authoring).
Reading or reviewing acceptances without creating or revising one.

profileRequirements.meaning: The concrete artifact kinds that constitute acceptance artifacts in the stack, so activation (file_kind = acceptance) and the check can be scoped to acceptances; the stack identifies them by file kind / path.
profileRequirements.bunValue: acceptance — note: 'Acceptance artifacts are identifiable by file kind / path.'

bunOnly.text: Source examples: metric telemetry:metric:be:order:created:duration (histogram, p95, 200ms); trace telemetry:trace:be:order:created (server); event telemetry:event:be:order:created / 'Order Created'.
bunOnly.reason: Concrete worked examples impose no obligation; bun.json is delivered as the reference example for other stacks, so the core carries only the normative URN shapes and allowed lists.

neutralityNotes: This rule governs the content of acceptance artifacts (telemetry signal naming), not stack mechanics: bun.json already names no stack, runtime, framework, language, path or suffix, so the core keeps the convention's own telemetry URN grammar and the plane/measure taxonomies verbatim — they originate in the canonical source's terms, are not Bun profile choices, and the closed vocabulary has no key (and needs none) for them. 'Planner' (authoring agent role) and 'wagon' (bounded product slice, used generically by the profile vocabulary itself, e.g. layout.wagon_dir) are ATDD-structural terms and were kept, with a gloss on first use of 'wagon'. The past-tense verb lexicon is referenced but not enumerated, exactly as in bun.json. Only the worked examples (verifier_detail[5]) remain realization-only, since bun.json is delivered as the reference example.
